---
title: 'NHIS: Adults Who Sought Out Massage'
author: "Tony Beal"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---
\
```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(patchwork)
path <- getwd()
setwd(path)
source("utils.R")
load("adult_nhis_data.RData")
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
masge_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(MASYR != 0) |> 
  select(MASYR)

masyr <- ggplot(masge_df, aes(factor(MASYR, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#77D6E6", color = "#376169", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to MASYR",
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 30000)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to MASYR", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "During the past 12 months, \ndid you see a practitioner of massage?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15, unit = "pt")), 
    plot.margin = margin(l = 25, unit = 'pt')
  )
print(masyr)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
msg_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$MASYR, 2)
msg_no <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$MASYR, 1)

msg_yes # n = 3136
msg_no  # n = 23443
# total = 26579
msg_yes_per <- round((msg_yes/nrow(adult_nhis_data))*100,2)
msg_no_per <- round((msg_no/nrow(adult_nhis_data))*100, 2)

```
MASYR: *"In the past 12 months have you seen a practitioner of massage?"*\
\
Yes: `r msg_yes`, (`r msg_yes_per`%)\
No: `r msg_no`, (`r msg_no_per`%)\
\
MASPAIN: *"In the past 12 months have you seen a practitioner of massage for pain?"*
```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

msg_pain_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$MASPAIN, 2)
msg_pain_no <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$MASPAIN, 1)

msg_pain_yes # n = 1701
msg_pain_no # n = 1433

# total = 3134

msg_pain_yes_per <- round((msg_pain_yes / msg_yes)*100, 2)
msg_pain_no_per <- round((msg_pain_no / msg_yes)*100, 2)

# 54.24% of the 3136  people who answered yes to using massage therapy in the  
# past year, reported seeing a massage therapist for pain management. 
```
Yes: `r msg_pain_yes`, (`r msg_pain_yes_per`%)\
No: `r msg_pain_no`, (`r msg_pain_no_per`%)\
\

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}
acu_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  select(ACUYR, ACUPAIN) 

p_acuyr <- ggplot(acu_df, aes(factor(ACUYR, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#6BABD6", color = "#243845", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to ACUYR", 
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 30000), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 30000, by = 5000)
    ) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to ACUYR", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "During the past 12 months, \ndid you see a practitioner of acupuncture?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15, unit = "pt"))
  )

acu_pain_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(ACUPAIN != 0) |> 
  select(ACUPAIN) 

p_acupain <- ggplot(acu_pain_df, aes(factor(ACUPAIN, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#6BABD6", color = "#243845", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to ACUPAIN", 
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 525), 
                     breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 550, by = 50)
                     ) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to ACUPAIN", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "During the past 12 months, \ndid you see a practitioner of acupuncture \nto treat or manage physical pain?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15, unit = "pt")),
    plot.margin = margin(l = 25, unit = 'pt')
  )
```
